content: DevNexus is a premium 1:1 skill exchange platform for Indian Gen-Z. It allows users to trade knowledge directly without money. Common swaps include React for UI Design, or Marketing for Python.

Our Smart Matching algorithm looks at your 'TEACH' list and matches it with others' 'LEARN' lists. When a mutual interest is found (A teaches what B learns, and vice versa), a connection is suggested.
We verify all emails. Users can endorse each other after a successful swap. We have a zero-tolerance policy for harassment or commercial solicitation.
DevNexus is free. We believe education should be accessible through community collaboration.
The AI Career Mentor (Gemini-powered) helps users optimize their learning paths and pitches their skills more effectively to potential partners.
